items.title: Audiotool 3.0 turns its multiplayer online DAW into an open platform for creator-built music tools
items.excerpt: Audiotool 3.0 rebuilds its multiplayer browser DAW around NEXUS, a new open-source SDK that lets musicians and developers build their own instruments, plugins, visualisers and AI-connected music tools directly into the platform — with AI integrations via MCP and Context I/O so creators can wire their preferred LLMs into the DAW. Launch partners include Splice, Ujam, BandM8 and Fraunhofer.

items.title: Record industry proposes AI labeling system for streaming platforms
items.excerpt: A coalition of eight music organizations (IFPI, RIAA, A2IM, WIN, IMPALA, the Recording Academy, SAG-AFTRA and the Human Artistry Campaign) proposes a voluntary streaming labeling standard with two tags — 'AI-generated' for fully AI tracks and 'AI-assisted' for human-led tracks that use AI — reshaping how AI-made music is disclosed to listeners.

items.title: New AI labeling standard for music draws support — and hesitation
items.excerpt: The recorded-music industry's proposed two-label framework for AI music draws broad agreement that transparency matters but exposes differing views on implementation, with responses from Suno and the Digital Media Association. The system remains voluntary and no major streaming service has committed to adopting it yet.

items.title: Suno says 'transparency is important' as record industry proposes AI labeling system
items.excerpt: AI music generator Suno backs the industry's proposed AI labeling system, saying it is investing in watermarking, audio fingerprinting and other tools 'that empower artists to disclose if they used AI in a song' — a notable stance from a platform still facing major-label copyright lawsuits.

items.title: BBC's music boss Lorna Clarke outlines broadcaster's AI transparency commitments
items.excerpt: The BBC will keep prioritising music that is 'the result of meaningful human creativity' while allowing AI-assisted work — but wants artists and labels to disclose how AI tools were used when submitting music. It signals how AI-in-the-workflow is becoming a disclosure expectation for creators, not just a licensing fight.

items.title: Google AI Mode now integrates with Canva, YouTube Music and Instacart
items.excerpt: Google's AI Mode in Search now hooks into YouTube Music, letting users generate and shape playlists conversationally from a prompt, alongside a Canva design integration — pushing AI-driven, chat-based curation deeper into how listeners assemble music.
